Method limit: every page fetch (plasticportal.eu, mnb.hu, allratestoday.com) failed on DNS from this sandbox; all new figures were read from search-engine extracts of the cited pages. 20 web searches used.

Commodity values use myCEPPI (weekly CEE average market price, week 37-38/2026 = mid-September; myCEPPI is Hungarian-run and covers HU with PL, CZ, SK) — the nearest direct-buy level for a tier-1 moulder. Plastech.pl October 2026 monthly OFFER averages (PE 1.59, PP 1.63 EUR/kg; 13 of 15 grades up m/m) run ~25-35% above myCEPPI for commodities and are given as the small-lot / distributor upper reference. myCEPPI news (9 and 16 Oct 2026): October olefin contract rose as expected; polyolefin increases only partly passed on.

Hungary-specific: MOL Petrochemicals (Tiszaújváros) is the domestic PP / HDPE / LDPE producer. An explosion at its Olefin-1 unit during restart on 22 May 2026 (1 dead, 8 seriously injured) was expected to cut polyolefin output and raise domestic prices (telex.hu, 2026-05-22, https://telex.hu/g7/vallalat/2026/05/22/tiszaujvaros-robbanas-aremelkedes-muanyagpiac-mol-baleset). No restart date and no MOL price list or price announcement was found.

Engineering resins, rubber polymers and composite inputs without a CEE series use European indices (businessanalytiq aggregator, IMARC / Expert Market Research vendors) carried from the Poland and Germany rounds — moderate to low confidence. Rubber book grades are 'xx Shore A' compounds and are not directly comparable with raw-polymer prices.

Book figures that look wrong (current v evidence, Ft/kg): mat-pc-abs 797.48 is below the resin content of its own blend (70/30 = 873.2; 50/50 = 815.5); mat-cf-dry-3k 10466.92 (3K woven fabric) is below 12K carbon fibre 10876.3; mat-pmma 996.85 v 1180.4 (-16%, before Trinseo's +250 EUR/t October increase); mat-pom 851.48 v 969.4 (Plastech Oct) / 972.5 (businessanalytiq Jul) (-12%); mat-hips 562.00 = GPPS but HIPS is 610.8; mat-pp-impact 426.62 v PPC 485.4 (-12%); mat-peek 32315.40 above Victrex's all-mix ASP 28869.4 (an upper bound). Possibly low, unconfirmed: mat-viton-fkm 9822.18 v FKM polymer 15098.8; mat-tpu-shore85 1046.69 v general PU 1244.4. High-looking, unconfirmed: mat-pp-gf30 767.10 (1.9x floor), mat-mb-black 926.24.

Not found: any market price for PA66-GF30, PA6-GF30, PP-GF30, PP-TD20, PC/ABS, PBT-GF30, flame-retardant grades, TPU, TPE-S, TPV, PA12 (KI / PIE compound lists paywalled; distributors quote-only); EPDM / NBR / CR / HCR / LSR rubber COMPOUND prices; SMC / BMC; T700 12K specifically; an October 2026 myCEPPI week; an MNB October 2026 rate.
